kjv: he (Moses), that was in the church in the wilderness
mine: the one (Moses) who was in the assembly in the wilderness
note: ekklesia here is Israel's assembly at Sinai (LXX "qahal"); "church" imports a Christian institution into the exodus.

kjv: brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles
mine: brought it (the tent of witness) in with Joshua
note: Iesous is the Greek form of Joshua; the KJV's "Jesus" makes Stephen speak of Jesus leading Israel into Canaan. Same at Heb 4:8.

kjv: a tabernacle for the God of Jacob
mine: a dwelling place for the house of Jacob
note: TR "theo" against "oiko" (P74, Sinaiticus*, B, D); "house" is the harder reading, so SBLGNT adopts it.

kjv: calling upon [God], and saying, Lord Jesus
note: The KJV supplies "God" (in italics); the object of "calling upon" is the Lord Jesus named next. The insertion turns a prayer to Jesus into a prayer to God.
